final: WITH groups AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, j.department, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY m.link_to_major COLLATE BINARY, j.department COLLATE BINARY), totals AS (SELECT SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups), shares AS (SELECT g.major_id, g.department, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.total_count AS group_share FROM groups AS g JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), department_averages AS (SELECT department, AVG(group_share) AS average_share FROM shares GROUP BY department COLLATE BINARY) SELECT s.major_id, s.department, s.group_count, s.group_share, s.group_share - d.average_share AS difference FROM shares AS s JOIN department_averages AS d ON s.department = d.department COLLATE BINARY WHERE s.group_share > d.average_share ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10
